title: App permissions: the install sheet on a TV
about: The install sheet (Valet, luma-application-installer) against design-center 8bd4ccf mockups/app-perms/install.html?posture=tv. Pixel mode: the app PNGs are crops of the VM (2x) from the Valet fixture tests/fixtures/valet-app-perms.json (LUMA_VALET_STATE=kiln|polychrome|cli). The reference's inline actions are left out: Valet keeps Install and Cancel at the window's foot. TV: Valet's phone column in TV posture (LUMA_POSTURE=tv), remote focus on the chosen level. Glyphs: the reference's Lucide SVGs at LumaUI's 1.6 stroke (Prairie's adaptation of every Lucide glyph), not Lucide's 2. The reference is captured at 2x (spec.scale) to match.

spec.eval:
(() => { const k='polychrome', cli=false, x=APX.APPS[k], w=document.getElementById('w-valet'), st=document.getElementById('stage'); w.style.setProperty('--a', x.a); w.style.setProperty('--b', x.b); if (document.documentElement.dataset.posture === 'desktop') st.innerHTML = `
${APX.head(k)}
${APX.sheet(k, cli)}
`; else { st.innerHTML = APX.sheetPhone(k, document.documentElement.dataset.posture === 'tv' ? 72 : 88); if (document.documentElement.dataset.posture === 'tv') st.querySelector('.vlp-list .vlp-row.on')?.classList.add('tvf'); } })()
